individual-data-points.explanation: Spatial transcriptomics panels are heatmap-type overlays of gene expression on tissue sections; heatmaps are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel B consists solely of micrograph (H&E and RNAscope fluorescence) images with no quantitative plot requiring individual data points.
Panel C is a scatter/dot plot in which every individual patient tumor value (n=500/512) is plotted as a separate point, with median and 95% CI overlaid.
Panel D is a bar chart with the individual replicate data points (n=3 per group) overlaid as dots on top of the mean +/- SD bars.

error-bars-defined.Decision_and_explanation: not needed - panel shows H&E micrograph and spatial expression heatmaps, no error bars or box-plot elements present.
